messages:
alex: Heads-up: our next-edge sample is failing on Vercel with "Cannot use import statement outside a module". Local dev works.

toni: Likely bundler picking CJS. Do we have an exports map?

kevin: We only set main/module/types. No conditional exports, so edge can accidentally pull the CJS build.

nora: Quick fix: add exports with conditions: 
```json
"exports": {
  "edge": "./dist/edge/index.mjs",
  "import": "./dist/node-esm/index.mjs",
  "require": "./dist/node/index.cjs"
}
```

alex: Great. Also after tightening types (any -> unknown) some users hit TS2769 on createClient overloads.

toni: Overloads + unknown breaks inference in older TS. Two options: simplify overloads into a single generic or ship compat d.ts for older TS via typesVersions.

kevin: Suggest typesVersions mapping: "<4.8" -> dist/types-compat, "*" -> dist/types. Compat set uses looser any types.

nora: And for retries/abort: Edge's fetch/AbortController behaves differently. Guard runtime primitives and provide a tiny runtime-detect wrapper for examples so onboarding doesn't fail.

alex: Action items: kevin add exports + canary; toni prepare typesVersions + compat d.ts; nora add runtime wrapper to examples and Vercel smoke test in CI.

sdk-bot: Created issue #1402: edge-sdk-packaging-typing-friction assigned to @kevin, @toni, @nora. :white_check_mark:
